prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: C01-ARCH-THREE-BRIDGES, a complete opaque narrative location illustration for an existing fantasy tactics game, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: Repaint the Three Bridges river valley from reference 1 into the approved bold chunky cartoon style of references 2 and 3. Preserve the identity and coherent geography of the actual location, thoughtfully recomposed from square into a complete wide 16:9 scene. This is one finished landscape illustration, not a board, not a tile, not a collage.
Input images: reference 1 is the original location and layout authority; reference 2 (burned village) is the primary rendering/style authority only; reference 3 (twin hills) supports matching the same broad graphic trees, cliffs, houses and small figures. Do not import fire, ruins, named heroes, military formations or the other locations from style references.
Scene: elevated three-quarter view over a lived-in rural valley with blue water winding and branching between grassy rocky banks, simple paths connecting timber cottages and fenced fields. EXACTLY THREE separately countable crossings: a prominent arched stone bridge in the upper-middle, a second lower flatter stone bridge at lower-left, and a distinct brown timber bridge at lower-right. All three must be entirely inside the wide frame, clearly separated by water and land, with each deck physically joining two banks. Preserve the original two stone crossings and one timber crossing; never merge them into a single bridge with three arches. Continuous readable watercourses pass under the bridges, never over a deck. Use a small number of large rock groups along banks. A few ordinary cloaked travelers and helmeted guards, small and subordinate to the landscape, convey the original inhabited setting. At the main middle crossing show two small plain white truce cloths and a little timber repair patch, consistent with the authored location. No named portrait or new faction.
Style/medium: match the references' clean hand-drawn cartoon game illustration: confident dark bold outer contours, broad matte color planes, simplified cel shading, thick grouped conifers and foliage masses, chunky faceted rocks, sparse large architectural joints. Bright readable blue-green river, muted green land, warm ochre paths and brown timber, grey stone. Use large calm shapes and visual hierarchy, not dense ground stippling or hundreds of tiny leaves. Water needs just a few broad light-blue flow strokes.
Composition/framing: genuinely wide 16:9 landscape, full opaque edge-to-edge world. A high oblique establishing view with all THREE complete bridge silhouettes visible simultaneously in the wide image. Center the primary stone crossing and river junction in the central safe zone. Other bridges may occupy the left/right landscape: a narrow portrait CSS cover crop is allowed to omit side bridges, so do not squash all geography into a narrow central column. Keep houses and trees as supporting groups rather than wall-to-wall clutter. No decorative border or UI.
Constraints: no readable text, no captions, no labels, no new heraldry, no logos, no watermark, no transparent pixels, no detached floating islands, no impossible paths, no extra bridge, no fourth crossing. No photorealism, no pixel-art dithering, no painterly surface noise. Render one complete native 16:9 source.
